blocks.prompt: 6. [Prove by mathematical induction:] \(4^n > 3^n + 2^{n-1}\) for integral values of \(n \ge 2\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi inequality hai jo \(n = 2\) se shuru hoti hai, is liye extended induction lagayenge jis ka base case \(n = 2\) hai.
\(n = 1\) par dono taraf 4 aata hai (\(4 = 3 + 1\)), is liye wahan "\(>\)" nahi chalta; isi wajah se sawal \(n \ge 2\) kehta hai.
Plan: hypothesis ko 4 se multiply karna, phir har tukre ka muqabla target ke \(3^{k+1}\) aur \(2^k\) se karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(S(n): 4^n > 3^n + 2^{n-1}\).
Saabit karna hai: \(S(n)\) har integer \(n \ge 2\) ke liye sahi hai.
Tareeqa: Extended mathematical induction: \(S(2)\) check karna; kisi \(k \ge 2\) par \(S(k)\) maanna; \(S(k + 1)\) saabit karna.

Base case: \(n = 2\) rakhein
\[4^2 = 16\]
\[3^2 + 2^1 = 9 + 2 = 11\]
\[16 > 11\]
Is liye \(S(2)\) sahi hai.
Kyun: Seedha hisaab: \(2^{n-1}\) mein \(n = 2\) rakhne se \(2^1 = 2\).

Induction hypothesis: \(S(k)\) ko sahi maan lein, \(k \ge 2\)
\[4^k > 3^k + 2^{k-1} \quad (A)\]
Kyun: Kisi integer \(k \ge 2\) par inequality ko sahi farz kiya.

Inductive step: (A) ko 4 se multiply karein
\[4^{k+1} = 4 \cdot 4^k\]
\[> 4 \cdot 3^k + 4 \cdot 2^{k-1}\]
\[= 4 \cdot 3^k + 2^{k+1}\]
Kyun: \(4^{k+1} = 4 \times 4^k\), is liye left side ko \(4^{k+1}\) banane ke liye (A) ko 4 se multiply kiya. 4 positive hai, nishan \(>\) wahi raha. Phir \(4 = 2^2\), to \(4 \cdot 2^{k-1} = 2^{2 + k - 1} = 2^{k+1}\).

Har tukre ka target se muqabla
\[4 \cdot 3^k > 3 \cdot 3^k = 3^{k+1}\]
\[2^{k+1} = 2 \cdot 2^k > 2^k\]
Kyun: \(3^k\) ke chaar hisse teen hisson se zyada hain, aur \(3 \cdot 3^k = 3^{k+1}\). Isi tarah \(2^{k+1}\), \(2^k\) ka dugna hai, is liye us se bara hai.
Dhyan dein: Inequality mein humein barabar nahi chahiye, bas itna dikhana hai ke hamara expression target se bara hai. Is liye kuch "chhor dena" jaiz hai, jab tak nishan sahi rahe.

Nateeje jorein
\[4^{k+1} > 4 \cdot 3^k + 2^{k+1}\]
\[> 3^{k+1} + 2^k\]
Is liye \(S(k + 1)\) sahi hai.
Kyun: Do bari cheezon ka jama, do chhoti cheezon ke jama se bara hota hai. Pehli kari (A) se aayi, doosri pichhle qadam se.

Conclusion
\(S(2)\) sahi hai aur har \(k \ge 2\) par \(S(k)\) se \(S(k + 1)\) sahi hota hai. Principle of extended mathematical induction se \(4^n > 3^n + 2^{n-1}\) har integer \(n \ge 2\) ke liye sahi hai.
Kyun: Induction ki dono sharten poori ho gayin.

Tasdeeq: \(n = 3\)
\[4^3 = 64\]
\[3^3 + 2^2 = 27 + 4 = 31,\quad 64 > 31 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Inequality sahi hai, aur \(4^n\) baaqi dono se tez barhta hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(4^n > 3^n + 2^{n-1}\) har integer \(n \ge 2\) ke liye.
